500.$description: Primary CTA background, active Dropdown item indicator, focus ring, Switch on-track, links

300.$description: Primary CTA hover/active state only. Darkened from the Figma-source #A8A4FF (2.23:1 against white on-primary text) to #5854BE (6.13:1) to meet WCAG AA 4.5:1 — caught by axe-core in plan 01-05's Storybook a11y checks.

500.$description: Destructive button, TextField error border/text. Darkened from the Figma-source #EA5555 (3.54:1 against white on-primary text, also 3.54:1 as error text on surface) to #C93F3C (4.93:1) to meet WCAG AA 4.5:1.

300.$description: Destructive button hover state only. Darkened from the Figma-source #FF9898 (2.06:1 against white on-primary text) to #B23632 (6.06:1) to meet WCAG AA 4.5:1.

500.$description: Placeholder/disabled/secondary text (dark theme; also placeholder/disabled in light theme, both exempt from axe's color-contrast rule)

550.$description: Secondary/muted real text content in light theme only (e.g. TextField's Field.Description). Darkened from the Figma-source #828FA3 (3.27:1 against white, caught by axe-core in plan 01-07's Storybook a11y checks). First darkened to #6B7686 (4.61:1 against bg-surface/#FFFFFF), which was sufficient until app/layout.tsx's <body> started painting bg-app (#F4F7FD, slightly darker than white) behind unwrapped page content in wave 7's dark-mode fix -- against that background #6B7686 only reached 4.29:1, failing AA. Darkened again to #66707F (4.67:1 against bg-app, 5.01:1 against bg-surface) so it passes against both real-world backgrounds this text can appear on, not just the one story happened to test. Kept separate from grey.500 rather than replacing it: grey.500 on dark-theme surfaces (#20212C/#2B2C37) already passes at 5.3:1/4.6:1, and darkening it further would only reduce that dark-mode margin for no light-mode benefit.
